schema_description: Directory-level resolved bootstrap-CI metadata sidecar. Covers all per-cell evaluation.json files under results/paper-eval/**/ produced by scripts/evaluate_detections.py. Does NOT cover sibling consensus-analysis-report.json or buffer_sensitivity.json files, which carry their own explicit metadata blocks.

coverage_subtrees.results/paper-eval/flash-*/consensus-ana: explicit metadata (YES in registry) - NOT covered by this sidecar
coverage_subtrees.results/paper-eval/pv/**/buffer_sensitiv: explicit metadata (YES in registry) - NOT covered by this sidecar

registry_commit_note: Sidecar written at repository HEAD e038bfe8 on 2026-04-20. Per-cell evaluation.json files were generated primarily on 2026-03-26/27 across subtrees.

invocation.source: script default, no run.log in cell directories
invocation.command_shape: python scripts/evaluate_detections.py --detections <per-cell consensus or single-pass detections> --buffers 20 30 40 50 --bootstrap 1000 --seed 42 --ground-truth <gold-standard geojson> --bounds <paper-eval bounds, varying per subtree>

per_cell_ci_count_typical: 3 metrics (F1, precision, recall) x 4 buffers = 12 CIs per cell; single-pass-t0-*m subtrees have 3 metrics x 1 buffer per cell
notes: Covers N=1 baselines (n1/), tile-MCC variants (mcc/), and single-pass-T=0 per-buffer cells. The consensus-analysis-report.json and buffer_sensitivity.json siblings are NOT covered here because they carry explicit in-file metadata.
